description_en: A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows
readme_excerpt: OpenAI Agents SDK The OpenAI Agents SDK is a lightweight yet powerful framework for building multi-agent workflows. It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs. > [!NOTE] > Looking for the JavaScript/TypeScript version? Check out Agents SDK JS/TS.
